title: Describing Places with Attitude and Relative Clauses
goal: Pack sensory detail and attitude into descriptions of places with *cuyo*, *por/desde donde* and non-restrictive clauses

items: I can use *cuyo / cuya / cuyos / cuyas* accurately to connect a place to its features.
I can use *por donde* and *desde donde* to describe movement and viewpoints.
I can add evaluative asides with non-restrictive relative clauses and sensory place vocabulary.
